title: November 3 — UlamInterlace: arithmetic lines, scale-locked XOR and a sampling microscope
summary: One new browser prime-spiral instrument interlaces up to six zoom levels and exposes two distinct structures: established quadratic-prime congruences and exact geometric cancellation from nearest-neighbour scale sampling. A 101×101 exact-arithmetic check at ratio 101/100 yields 1, 9 and 49 universally white XOR rectangles with 2, 4 and 6 layers. Potential applications to image-registration diagnostics are proposed but not benchmarked.

nodes.claim: Single-file local/browser multiscale Ulam-prime visualizer with 1–6 independently scaled spiral layers, row/column/checker/square-ring/round-ring interlace, Overlay/XOR/Coincide, centre offset and ratio controls; includes mathematical analysis scripts, video and an exact XOR-zone checker.
nodes.survived: A six-layer integer-cell source reproduces quadratic prime-line structure and near-rational modular coincidence effects. Independently checked at base 1 px/cell and ratio 101/100, the XOR operator has universally white 1×1, 3×3 and 7×7 Cartesian rectangle families at L=2,4,6 (10,201 / 7,225 / 4,225 forced-white pixels in the ±50 window); the centre-lock half-widths are 50,25,17,12,10 for L=2–6. The source-linked README separately reports a ratio-2 Euler-diagonal Coincide control.
nodes.killed: The beautiful white boxes are produced by resampling geometry and XOR parity even for arbitrary binary images, not a new prime theorem. The 3-adic/Cantor, physical caustic and Talbot-carpet descriptions are not established. Below 1 px/cell Coincide multiplies density shades, not binary primality. No measured advantage over ordinary image registration, SIFT/DoG, temporal differences or existing VHS stitching has been shown.
nodes.era: November 3: prime spirals reveal a scale-sampling operator

motifs.title: Scale disagreement is an operator measurement before it is a claim about the observed field
motifs.description: Near-identity nearest-neighbour resampling creates exact stable and disagreement zones; XOR of an even number of matching sampled pairs cancels for any binary field. In UlamInterlace the 1/9/49 box genealogy is geometry; primes supply independent arithmetic texture. For SweepAtlas and VHSImageStitch the potential use is detecting scale or resampling errors, not an implemented or benchmarked shared algorithm.
